title: Radical Allyship & Queer Careers
abstract: This session explores how engineers and scientists can practice radical allyship and create supportive environments across academia and industry. Speakers will also share strategies for navigating LGBTQ+ career paths and building affirming workplaces. The program concludes with small-group discussions where attendees can reflect, connect, and exchange ideas for allyship and career success.
authors: Kay Glass | The Pennsylvania State University, University Park, PA
